name: Eternity
source:
”Our Heroine, Haruna, receives a letter just before summer vacation starts. Said letter, is a request to tutor her cousin from the uncle she hasn’t met for several years.

Meetings, reunions, partings. The truth found at the end of summer is–"

[from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/04/16/otome-game-review-eternity-by-prism-orbit/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
我们的女主角春奈在暑假开始前收到了一封信。信中是多年未见的叔叔寄来的请求，希望她辅导自己的表亲。

相遇、重逢、离别。夏日尽头等待着她的真相是——

[来自 [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/04/16/otome-game-review-eternity-by-prism-orbit/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
